meta.description: Reads the project's attested [OpenSSF Scorecard](https://scorecard.dev) results. Fails when Scorecard reports that changes to the primary branch do not require a review from another party.
meta.name: Code Review Required

error.message: Scorecard detected code review is not enabled in the repository
